races.name: Strawmax Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Dartmouth Castle
runners_data.note: Front running style suits small field dynamics, 26 days since impressive wide-margin win, proven at similar trip and going conditions.
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner on fast ground; off the mark over hurdles last time (made all); solid claims
runners_data.spotlight: Sedgefield bumper winner last May (2m1f, good to firm); off the mark over hurdles with a wide-margin success on same track last time (2m4f, good; made all; left clear two out); the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Kashchei
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs strong pace to be effective, 38 days off with disappointing recent form, cheekpieces reapplied suggest connections seeking improvement.
runners_data.comment: Maiden; two fair runs on soft/heavy in the winter; well beaten latest; bit to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Irish raider; exposed maiden; two fair runs on soft/heavy this year but well beaten with cheekpieces tried (on again) at Downpatrick last time (2m6f, yielding to soft); bit to prove.

runners_data.name: Rupert The Prince
runners_data.note: Hurdling debutant from Flat background, 7lb apprentice claim valuable, visor first-time application indicates stepping up in trip expectation.
runners_data.comment: Fair stayer on the Flat; cost 36,000gns; poor effort on jumps debut; can do better
runners_data.spotlight: Won three times at up to 2m on the Flat for Paddy Butler; bought for 36,000gns in October; third in a 2m handicap at Ripon 11 days ago having disappointed in a Newcastle maiden hurdle on jumps debut in January (2m1f, good to soft; cheekpieces on instead of visor); visor back on, this longer trip should suit, and improvement likely.

races.paceDynamic: Dartmouth Castle holds the early initiative as the sole confirmed front runner, with both Rupert The Prince and potentially Kashchei settling in behind. The small field and lack of pace pressure means Dartmouth Castle can dictate terms without being harried early, likely setting sustainable fractions through the first mile. Kashchei's hold-up style means he'll need the pace to be strong enough to set up his finishing kick, but with Dartmouth Castle unopposed early, this may develop into a tactical affair. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and front runners who can control the tempo and kick clear when the pressure comes.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Dartmouth Castle gets uncontested early lead and sustainable pace
scenarios.body: McCain's runner dictates ideal fractions and has the class edge to repel challenges when they come. His recent wide-margin success shows he can make all effectively when allowed to control proceedings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Kashchei finds the race run to suit his finishing kick
scenarios.body: The Irish raider gets the strong pace he needs late in the race to unleash his turn of foot. His hold-up style becomes an advantage if the leaders go too fast or the race becomes truly run.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Novice Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If Rupert The Prince adapts quickly to hurdling on debut
scenarios.body: The Flat winner benefits from prominent position and stamina reserves at this longer trip. His recent third at Ripon suggests current form, and the 7lb claim helps offset inexperience.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Finish
scenarios.trigger: If pace becomes overly tactical with no early pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and finishing kick matter most. Dartmouth Castle's ability to quicken off slow pace gives him tactical flexibility others lack.

watchPoints.text: Dartmouth Castle breaking quickly and getting uncontested early lead - if unopposed he can dictate ideal fractions
Kashchei's position through early stages - needs to be handy enough if pace becomes tactical
Rupert The Prince's jumping fluency on debut - any mistake could end chances in small field
Pace development after first hurdle - tactical crawl would compromise Kashchei's finishing kick
Dartmouth Castle's response to first serious challenge - will show if ready to win again after 26-day break

races.name: Racing TV Profits Returned To Racing Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Walk On Quest
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong course form who was narrowly beaten here last time and should relish tracking the leader
runners_data.comment: Won 4 handicaps 2 seasons ago; sound run when beaten a nose over C&D latest; contender
runners_data.spotlight: Won four handicaps on the trot two seasons ago (2m-2m5f, good to soft/soft); hasn't won since but was beaten only by a nose over C&D on good last time; contender.

runners_data.name: The Clonmel Kid
runners_data.note: Prominent type coming off a confidence-boosting chase win but faces a significant step up in class here
runners_data.comment: Off the mark on second chase start last time (2m4f); seems to stay 3m; stiffer task
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark on second chase start when scoring at Newcastle last time (2m4f, good); seems to stay 3m, but this looks tougher.

runners_data.name: Presentandcounting
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with extensive good going experience who can control the race from the front

races.paceDynamic: Presentandcounting will set the tempo from the front with no other natural leaders in this three-runner field. Walk On Quest and The Clonmel Kid will both track the 12-year-old in prominent positions, creating a slow-building race where the pace will only quicken from the home turn. With just three runners and one confirmed front runner, this sets up as a tactical affair where positioning and timing will be crucial. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leader and produce a sustained challenge, as Presentandcounting may dictate terms too easily if allowed an uncontested lead.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Presentandcounting gets an easy lead and controls the fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The veteran can use his experience to dictate a pace that suits him perfectly, kicking clear from the last fence. His proven stamina and course form make him dangerous when allowed to dominate from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Walk On Quest or The Clonmel Kid apply pressure to Presentandcounting from halfway
scenarios.body: The sustained pressure forces the leader to crack in the closing stages, allowing the prominent tracker to strike late. Walk On Quest's proven ability at this course gives him the edge in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes very slow and it turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows all three to stay in contention turning for home, favouring the horse with the best turn of foot. The Clonmel Kid's recent winning form could prove decisive in a dash to the line.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leader Fades Early
scenarios.trigger: If Presentandcounting makes jumping errors or goes too fast early
scenarios.body: The front runner's 12-year-old legs give way under pressure, leaving Walk On Quest and The Clonmel Kid to fight it out. Walk On Quest's course experience becomes the deciding factor in a two-horse battle.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Presentandcounting gets too keen early as his 12-year-old frame may not handle sustained pressure over this trip
Monitor Walk On Quest's jumping rhythm as any mistakes will be costly in such a small field where positioning is crucial
Observe The Clonmel Kid's ability to cope with this class rise after his maiden chase success at Newcastle
Check the early pace as a crawling tempo will neutralize Presentandcounting's main advantage
Watch for any market moves on The Clonmel Kid given trainer Philip Kirby's solid recent strike rate

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: High Dancer
runners_data.note: Prominent runner could be key to pressuring Kilmore Rock but trainer Nicky Richards is struggling for form recently.
runners_data.comment: Disappointing in last two runs and needs to get back near his best to make an impact
runners_data.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle (2m5f, good) for James Ewart last spring; runner-up in C&D handicap next time but he's not gone on from that and has been disappointing in last two runs; drops back in trip/grade but he needs to get back near his best to make an impact.

runners_data.name: Rexem
runners_data.note: Hold-up style on a 38-day break returning from chasing, with headgear change adding unknown factor to his chances.
runners_data.comment: Pulled up in Ulster National (3m4f) latest but he needs a close look back over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up in the Ulster National (3m4f, soft) in March but he was runner-up in two chase handicaps at Musselburgh (2m4f/2m7f) before that; now returns to hurdling but he's 3-8 in this sphere and is on a dangerous mark on this drop back in trip and grade; one to keep an eye on.

runners_data.name: Kilmore Rock
runners_data.note: Front-runner with ideal tactical scenario, wearing blinkers again after course and distance success just 16 days ago.
runners_data.comment: Won this last year and he was good as ever when scoring over C&D last month; key player
runners_data.spotlight: Won this race last year and he improved his hurdling record to 5-13 when beating Jericoacoara over C&D (second-time blinkers) two weeks ago; up 6lb but he was as good as ever with that comfortable success and is a major player again.

runners_data.name: Rememberthename
runners_data.note: Hold-up type moving up significantly in class after maiden hurdle success, faces tactical disadvantage but stays well.
runners_data.comment: Justified favouritism over 2m2f here last time and he's respected back up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the ninth attempt over hurdles when justifying favouritism in a handicap here (2m2f, good) last month; this is tougher off 5lb higher but he seems versatile trip-wise and he still has potential; respected for in-form yard.

runners_data.name: Jericoacoara
runners_data.note: Another hold-up runner needing strong pace to be effective, apprentice Joshua Thompson's 5lb claim is valuable asset.
runners_data.comment: In-form 7yo who was runner-up over C&D last time; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to add to his French hurdle win (2m1f, very soft) in 2023 but he's been placed in last three runs including when second behind Kilmore Rock over C&D (good) last month; should go well again and any rain would be a bonus.

runners_data.name: Starlyte
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran back on last winning mark with tongue-tie applied, but poor recent form suggests he needs everything to fall right.
runners_data.comment: On last winning mark but she was well held behind Kilmore Rock over C&D last month
runners_data.spotlight: Won over 2m5f here (good to soft) last March but he's 0-11 since and was a well-held fourth behind Kilmore Rock over C&D last month; now back on last winning mark but she's not easy to predict and others are preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Kilmore Rock will dictate from the front with no other natural leaders, allowing him to set his own sustainable tempo through the early stages. The remaining five runners (High Dancer prominent, Rexem/Rememberthename/Jericoacoara/Starlyte all hold-up types) will sit behind in a compact group, creating a patient tactical affair. This uncontested lead scenario over 2m6½f on good ground heavily favours front-runners who can control their own destiny, while the lack of early pace pressure means hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage needing the race to develop into a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Kilmore Rock Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Kilmore Rock gets his own way in front without early pressure
scenarios.body: The defending champion dictates a steady tempo before quickening approaching the final flight, making full use of his tactical advantage. Hold-up horses struggle to peg back a horse who has controlled every aspect of the race from flag to finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed turns this into a 3-4 furlong dash where the strongest finishers can overcome Kilmore Rock's positional advantage. Rexem's class or Rememberthename's recent winning form could prove decisive in a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: High Dancer Pressures
scenarios.trigger: If High Dancer goes forward to pressure Kilmore Rock early
scenarios.body: The only prominent runner forces a stronger pace that could crack Kilmore Rock's resistance, while also setting up the race for the hold-up horses behind. This tactical shift completely changes the complexion from a front-runner's paradise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Kilmore Rock stops dramatically in the final furlong after controlling
scenarios.body: The leader pays for his long stint in front when multiple hold-up horses swamp him close home. Even unfancied runners like Starlyte could benefit from such a dramatic turn of events.

watchPoints.text: Kilmore Rock getting an uncontested lead could make this race tactical suicide for the hold-up horses behind
High Dancer's early positioning will be crucial - if he sits off Kilmore Rock rather than pressuring, the race is over
Rexem switching back to hurdles after chasing could either refresh him or leave him needing the run
The patient tactics of four hold-up horses could backfire spectacularly if nobody applies early pressure
Rememberthename stepping up markedly in grade after his maiden success may find this level beyond him

runners_data.name: Larkfield Lusive

runners_data.name: Fairly Fulling

races.paceDynamic: Abbey Scope will likely lead from the start with William Yeats, Livano Bello, and Larkfield Lusive providing early company in a race lacking genuine pace pressure. The moderate early gallop will allow the field to stay compact through the middle stages, with the hold-up horses like Cher Tara, Nitty Gritty, and Disco Annie tracking in behind. This sets up a tactical finish where positioning and stamina reserves become crucial over the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those who can quicken late, as the steady pace will leave plenty in reserve for a sustained drive up the hill.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected with Abbey Scope leading unchallenged
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade will have too much finishing kick for the early leaders who lack genuine pace pressure. Cher Tara and Nitty Gritty can time their runs perfectly while Disco Annie benefits from the strong gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Sustain
scenarios.trigger: If William Yeats or Livano Bello can inject more pace than expected mid-race
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will stretch the field and favour those racing handy who can maintain their position. Livano Bello's consistency and William Yeats' recent form give them the edge over tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Long Absence Returns
scenarios.trigger: If Larkfield Lusive shows no rustiness despite the 263-day break
scenarios.body: His proven ability on good ground and past course form at this trip could see him surprise despite the layoff. She Won't Mind also returns from a lengthy break but faces bigger fitness concerns.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leaders Hold On
scenarios.trigger: If Abbey Scope sets stronger fractions than anticipated and maintains momentum
scenarios.body: The pace pressure could compromise the hold-up horses' finishing kicks and allow the early leader to stay clear. This scenario requires Abbey Scope to bounce back from his last run.

watchPoints.text: She Won't Mind carries serious fitness concerns after 351-day break and history of bleeding from nose
Larkfield Lusive returns after 263 days off and may need this run despite previous course success
Abbey Scope pulled up last time and must prove the desire is still there from the front
Nitty Gritty has disappointed since leaving Joseph O'Brien but retains ability if recapturing Irish form
Watch the early pace as genuine pressure could compromise the hold-up horses' preferred tactics

races.paceDynamic: Thorneylands will lead from the start but faces immediate pressure from four prominent runners (Vanilla Dancer, Maillot Blanc, Lone Star, Royal Maggs) who will all want forward positions. This congestion creates a genuine pace battle through the early stages, with the pace likely honest rather than crawling. The hold-up horses (Return To Florida, Helsgetaway, Long Time Listener, Venturevango) will have plenty to do from off the pace. This race shape clearly favours the prominent runners who can secure good positions without getting caught in the early scrap, as they'll have tactical advantage when the pace inevitably slows mid-race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace battle settles into a rhythm after the first mile with prominent runners in control
scenarios.body: The leaders will have established their positions and can control the tempo, making it difficult for hold-up horses to close. Vanilla Dancer and Maillot Blanc are perfectly positioned to capitalize from their forward berths.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Mid-Race
scenarios.trigger: If Thorneylands and the prominent pack go too fast early and come back dramatically
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop will set up a closing finish where stamina and a turn of foot become crucial. Return To Florida's longer trip experience and Helsgetaway's 3m form could prove decisive in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Thorneylands Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Thorneylands gets an uncontested lead with the prominent pack settling behind rather than pressuring
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate a steady pace and kick clear before the field organizes a challenge. Thorneylands' front-running style becomes a major weapon rather than a liability in this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If the early battle is so fierce that multiple leaders stop quickly and the race becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: An extreme scenario where early pace casualties create chaos and the race becomes about who has anything left. Long Time Listener's hold-up style and lighter weight could prove advantageous in a war of attrition.

Return To Florida needs the pace to be strong enough to set up his hold-up style
Royal Maggs trying hood first time could either sharpen him up or send him too keen
Long Time Listener's 16-day break might leave him needing the run despite his light weight

runners_data.spotlight: Best run over fences when 3.25l second to Tanking Along (13lb worse off) at Sedgefield in March (2m, good); reportedly ran flat when well beaten at Southwell next time (2m4f, good); should fare better.

races.paceDynamic: Tanking Along is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from flag to finish without pressure. Chapel Green, Flash Du Pistolet, Glory And Honour and Intenzo will settle prominently behind the leader, creating a compact group through the early stages. The hold-up pair Moodofthemoment and Singapore Trip will drop out the back and rely on staying on late. This setup creates a sustainable pace that strongly favours the prominent runners who can track Tanking Along and kick when the pace lifts, rather than the hold-up horses who need a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and the prominent group stays intact
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Chapel Green, Flash Du Pistolet or Glory And Honour to travel comfortably and strike late. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back on the moderate gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Tanking Along maintains his lead and isn't passed late
scenarios.body: His proven course form and front-running style suit the tactical setup perfectly. The sustainable pace plays to his strengths as others struggle to reel him in.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly in the straight
scenarios.body: Singapore Trip's hat-trick form and Moodofthemoment's class allow them to pick up the pieces. The prominent group goes too early and weakens late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Tanking Along goes too slow and gets swamped early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the freshest horses prevail. Class and recent form become decisive factors.

races.paceDynamic: Brandy McQueen and Settle Down Jill will clash from the off, both being confirmed front runners who need to lead or sit prominently. This honest gallop will be sustained over the 2m7½f trip, with the leaders setting a searching pace that will test stamina reserves. The strong early pace will inevitably weaken both front runners in the closing stages, creating opportunities for the hold-up horses to close late. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up merchants who can conserve energy early and finish powerfully when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Brandy McQueen and Settle Down Jill duel early as expected
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will drain both leaders, allowing Northern Bound, Whatdeawant, and Eagles Rock to close strongly from off the pace. The superior class horses sitting back will have too much finishing kick for tired leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Brandy Gets Loose
scenarios.trigger: If Brandy McQueen can clear Settle Down Jill and steal a march
scenarios.body: Without a sustained duel, Brandy can dictate terms and may have enough left to hold off late challenges. Her recent winning form gives her the edge over other front runners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Dressedtoimpress can track the leaders without getting caught up in early battles
scenarios.body: Sitting just behind the speed duel, she can benefit from the honest pace without expending energy early. Her recent good form suggests she can pick up the pieces when others weaken.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse of Favourites
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is too strong and all the fancied horses underperform
scenarios.body: Royal Cave or Eagles Rock could sneak through at big odds if the market leaders fail to handle the conditions. This would require a complete tactical breakdown from the prominent runners.
